records.key: There are no complete sets to sort.
records.source: There are no complete sets to sort.
records.translation: 没有可整理的完整数据组。

records.key: Two channels cannot both give the {roles} mask.
records.source: Two channels cannot both give the {roles} mask.
records.translation: 两个通道不能同时提供 {roles} 掩膜。
{image} 的形状为 {shape}，不是单个 2-D 平面。

records.key: The mask of {image} is {mask_shape}; the image is {shape}.
records.source: The mask of {image} is {mask_shape}; the image is {shape}.
records.translation: {image} 的掩膜形状为 {mask_shape}；图像形状为 {shape}。

records.key: The images of set {name} differ in size: {sizes}
records.source: The images of set {name} differ in size: {sizes}
records.translation: 数据组 {name} 中的图像大小不同：{sizes}

records.key: {count} set(s) have no {role} mask in channel {channel}. Those sets cannot be merged when merging is requested.
records.source: {count} set(s) have no {role} mask in channel {channel}. Those sets cannot be merged when merging is requested.
records.translation: {count} 个数据组缺少 {role} 掩膜，缺失位置为通道 {channel}。请求合并时，这些数据组无法合并。

records.key: No channel has masks. When merging is requested, stack/ is written but merged/ is not.
records.source: No channel has masks. When merging is requested, stack/ is written but merged/ is not.
records.translation: 所有通道都没有掩膜。请求合并时，会写入 stack/，但不会写入 merged/。

records.key: Move {images} image(s) and {masks} mask(s) into {channels} channel folder(s) under {dest}, as {sets} set(s) in Yokogawa naming. Then build channel stacks and any merged arrays supported by the available masks.
records.source: Move {images} image(s) and {masks} mask(s) into {channels} channel folder(s) under {dest}, as {sets} set(s) in Yokogawa naming. Then build channel stacks and any merged arrays supported by the available masks.
records.translation: 将 {images} 张图像和 {masks} 个掩膜移至 {channels} 个通道文件夹中，这些文件夹位于 {dest} 下，组成 {sets} 个按 Yokogawa 规则命名的数据组。然后构建通道堆栈及可用掩膜所支持的合并数组。

records.key: Move {images} image(s) into {dest} using Yokogawa names, with {masks} mask(s) in {masks_dir}. Do not write stacks or merged arrays.
records.source: Move {images} image(s) into {dest} using Yokogawa names, with {masks} mask(s) in {masks_dir}. Do not write stacks or merged arrays.
records.translation: 使用 Yokogawa 名称将 {images} 张图像移至 {dest}，并将 {masks} 个掩膜放在 {masks_dir} 中。不写入堆栈或合并数组。
{sets} 个完整数据组，涵盖 {channels} 个通道。
